verdict.scam.brand: This is a scam: it does not come from {brand}.
command.owner_only: Only the business owner can do this.
enroll.ask: Hi, I'm VIGIA. To enroll your business send: hello <business name> <country>. For example: hello Corner Hardware US
enroll.done: Done: {business} is enrolled and you are the owner. Add your team with: team +1 202 555 0100 Name. From now on, forward me anything suspicious.
enroll.already: You are already enrolled in VIGIA. Send help to see the commands.
team.request_received: Got the request for {name}. If their number is available, they can start forwarding me suspicious messages now.
contact.taken: That number or email is already enrolled in VIGIA.
email.code_sent: I sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Whoever gets it must reply from their WhatsApp: code 123456. It expires in 15 minutes.
email.code_body: Your VIGIA code is {code}. Reply on WhatsApp with: code {code}. It expires in 15 minutes.
email.verified: Email verified. You can now forward suspicious emails to VIGIA.
email.code_invalid: That code is not valid. Check it or ask for another with: my email you@email.com
email.code_rate_limited: I did not send the code: that address or your business already got several codes in the last hour. Please wait a while and try again.
email.code_locked: Too many attempts with a wrong code. That code no longer works; request a new one with: my email you@email.com
email.code_none: I have no pending code for you. Ask for one with: my email you@email.com
supplier.added: Supplier {name} saved to your address book.
history.empty: Your business has no verdicts yet.
help: VIGIA commands: forward me any suspicious message to check it. history: last 5 verdicts. my email you@email.com: link your email. Owner only: team +1 202 555 0100 Name [email], supplier Name email=... account=... and scam confirmed <id>
case.empty: Forward me the suspicious message (text, screenshot, voice note, PDF or email) and I will tell you if it is a scam. Write help to see the commands.
case.unsupported: I can't check this kind of file yet. Send me text, a screenshot, a voice note, a PDF or an email.
action.ignore: You don't need to do anything.
action.verify_official_channel: What to do: don't reply on this channel; verify through the official channel.
action.dont_open_link: What to do: don't open the link or reply.
action.dont_pay: What to do: don't pay or share account details until you confirm through the official channel.
action.report: What to do: don't open the link or reply. We will report it.
team_alert.scam: ⚠️ {reporter} reported a {brand} scam ({kind}). If it reaches you, don't open it. VIGIA
escalation.unknown: I have no pending action with that id.
escalation.transfer_confirmed: Done, {target} is now the owner of this business.
signal.brand_off_domain: the link is not on the official domain of the brand it imitates
signal.lookalike_domain: the domain imitates an official one
signal.brand_in_path: mentions a known brand in the link's path
signal.suspicious_tld: the link uses a high-risk domain
signal.ip_or_port: the link uses an IP address or an unusual port
signal.unresolved_shortener: the shortened link could not be checked
signal.could_not_verify: the link could not be verified
signal.official_domain: the link is on an official domain
signal.http_without_tls: the link does not use a secure connection
signal.qr_to_unofficial_domain: the QR code leads to a domain that is not official
signal.credentials_request: asks for your passwords or login details
signal.personal_payment_release: asks for a personal payment to release something
signal.personal_payment: asks for a payment to a personal account
signal.authority_with_link: poses as an authority next to a link
signal.supplier_from_unknown_origin: claims to be a known supplier but writes from a different number or email
signal.account_differs_from_known: asks to pay into an account different from the known one
signal.known_campaign: matches a scam campaign already reported
escalation.transfer_requested: To hand the business over to {target}, reply *confirm {id}* (expires in 24 h) or *cancel {id}*.
escalation.not_pending: That action is no longer pending.
escalation.expired: That action expired: request it again.
escalation.not_allowed: That action cannot run from this channel.
transfer.not_member: That number is not on your team. Add it first with *team*.
signal.advance_before_seeing: asks for a deposit before you see the item
signal.staggered_charges: a new charge shows up after you paid
signal.pressure_after_payment: pressures you with losing what you already paid
signal.personal_account_only: only takes payment to a personal account
signal.price_below_market: the price is far below market
signal.verification_evasion: avoids letting you verify (video call, visit or address)
signal.identity_mismatch: the account is in someone else's name
action.dont_pay_sale: What to do: don't pay. If you want the item, ask for a live video call and pay on delivery. Report the profile where you saw the listing.
action.stop_paying: What to do: stop paying, every new charge is part of the scam. Keep screenshots, block the number, report the account to your bank or payment app and file a police report. The report helps stop them.
action.block_and_report: What to do: this is extortion. Don't reply, block the number and report it.
audio.unsupported: I can't listen to this audio format yet. Meanwhile, type what the voice note says or forward the original message.
audio.too_long: The voice note is too long. Send me the suspicious part or type what it says.
audio.too_large: The audio file is too large. Send me a shorter voice note or type what it says.
audio.unavailable: I couldn't listen to the voice note right now. Please send it again in a few minutes.
image.invalid: I couldn't open that image. Send me a PNG or JPG screenshot, or paste the text.
image.too_large: That image is too large. Send me a regular screenshot, or paste the text.
image.unavailable: I couldn't read the image right now. Please send it again in a few minutes.
pdf.invalid: That file doesn't look like a valid PDF. Send me a screenshot of the document or paste its text.
pdf.too_large: The PDF is too large. Send me only the suspicious page or a screenshot.
pdf.unavailable: I couldn't read the PDF right now. Please send it again in a few minutes.
panel.title: VIGÍA · operator panel
panel.col.label: Verdict
team_alert.scam_unbranded: ⚠️ {reporter} reported a scam ({kind}). If it reaches you, don't open it. VIGIA
scam_confirmed.done: Thanks. I saved this scam's fingerprint (without the text or the numbers) to recognize it if it comes back.
scam_confirmed.unknown: I couldn't find that case in your business. Copy the id exactly as it appears in VIGIA's reply.
scam_confirmed.nothing: That case has no links and too little text to recognize it later. I saved nothing.
attachment.too_large: The file is over 10 MB and I can't check it. Send me a screenshot or the message text.
attachment.unavailable: I couldn't download the file right now. Please send it again in a few minutes.
